sections.text: Protection

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Over Voltage Relay
 12IAV71A3A Type IAV
General Electric
Introduction

This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, to be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 
in the title block.

This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the relay.

The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Mahmoud Osman, tested by eng. Eslam 
Mphamed Abas, accepted by eng. Sawsan Mohamed El-Lethy: Port 
Said general director, approved by eng Hamdy Abd El-Moly Melegy: Head sector, and certified by eng. Zakaria El-Shahat: EDEPC MPIS 
Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Equipment isolation (disconnect switches are opened and tagged)

Measure the current circuit of the relay by clip ammeter to be sure that is no 
 current

Make sure ct secondary are shorted before isolating relay current 
 circuits for test current injection

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Secondary injection test set

Test leads, clamp ammeter, voltmeter,
 Test plug
Complete tool set

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Disconnect the circuit 
breaker for generator

Removed the plug of 
connection for over voltage relay

Put the test plug of 
connection in over voltage relay

Connect test leads between 
the test set and the voltage terminal (5&6) for the over voltage relay as shown 
in fig 1

Connect test leads between 
the test set and the time terminal (1&2) for the over voltage relay

Inject voltage drop (120 
v) in the voltage terminal (5&6)

Increase the injection 
voltage slowly until the red indication on the over voltage relay appears

Record this value, 
operating voltage (123v) and the time on the test sheet adjust it if needed
Switch off the test set

from terminal on the relay.

Remove the test plug from 
the relay.

Put the plug of connection 
for time-over current relay.
